topic: What if you had an iPhone 100 years ago?

script.text: You wake up on a cobblestone street. Horses. Hats. Smoke. And everyone is staring at the glowing thing in your hand.
Your phone. You snap a photo. In full color. Instantly. A man in a bowler hat faints.
You play a song. A crowd forms. Nobody here has ever heard music come out of a pocket.
A policeman asks if it's a bomb. You show him a cat video. He laughs so hard he drops his whistle.
You grab a newspaper. October, 1926. One hundred years ago. And the only smartphone on Earth is yours.
What if you had an iPhone, one hundred years ago?
Sounds like you'd be a god. But that little phone is about to become the most dangerous object on the planet. And it's already counting down.

shots.note: you wake on the cobbles, the phone glowing
a car rattles past, hats everywhere
three faces stare at the glow
you lift it, the flash fires
the man in the bowler hat faints
the lady in the cloche, delighted
the policeman: is it a bomb?
